CREATE TABLE consultancy_project (
    staff_activity_id BIGINT UNSIGNED PRIMARY KEY,
    consultancy_title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    client_organization_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    principal_consultant_employee_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    consultancy_type ENUM('CONSULTANCY','INDUSTRY_SPONSORED_PROJECT','TESTING_SERVICE','TRAINING_SERVICE','OTHER')
        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CONSULTANCY',
    work_order_number VARCHAR(150) NULL,
    agreement_number VARCHAR(150) NULL,
    purchase_order_number VARCHAR(150) NULL,
    project_start_date DATE NOT NULL,
    completion_date DATE NULL,
    consultancy_amount DECIMAL(16,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
    amount_received DECIMAL(16,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
    faculty_incentive_share DECIMAL(16,2) NULL,
    currency_code CHAR(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR',
    deliverables TEXT NULL,
    status ENUM('PROPOSED','APPROVED','ONGOING','COMPLETED','CANCELLED','CLOSED') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PROPOSED',
    client_feedback TEXT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT chk_consultancy_dates CHECK (
        completion_date IS NULL OR completion_date >= project_start_date
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_consultancy_amounts CHECK (
        consultancy_amount >= 0 AND amount_received >= 0
        AND (faculty_incentive_share IS NULL OR faculty_incentive_share >= 0)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT fk_consultancy_activity FOREIGN KEY (staff_activity_id)
        REFERENCES staff_activity(staff_activity_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_consultancy_client FOREIGN KEY (client_organization_id)
        REFERENCES external_organization(organization_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_consultancy_principal FOREIGN KEY (principal_consultant_employee_id)
        REFERENCES employee(employee_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

  `purchase_order_number` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,

  `completion_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `consultancy_amount` decimal(16,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `amount_received` decimal(16,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',

  `deliverables` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `status` enum('PROPOSED','APPROVED','ONGOING','COMPLETED','CANCELLED','CLOSED') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PROPOSED',
  `client_feedback` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  PRIMARY KEY (`staff_activity_id`),
  KEY `fk_consultancy_client` (`client_organization_id`),
  KEY `fk_consultancy_principal` (`principal_consultant_employee_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_consultancy_activity` FOREIGN KEY (`staff_activity_id`) REFERENCES `staff_activity` (`staff_activity_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_consultancy_client` FOREIGN KEY (`client_organization_id`) REFERENCES `external_organization` (`organization_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_consultancy_principal` FOREIGN KEY (`principal_consultant_employee_id`) REFERENCES `employee` (`employee_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_consultancy_amounts` CHECK (((`consultancy_amount` >= 0) and (`amount_received` >= 0) and ((`faculty_incentive_share` is null) or (`faculty_incentive_share` >= 0)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_consultancy_dates` CHECK (((`completion_date` is null) or (`completion_date` >= `project_start_date`)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

  CONSTRAINT `platform_consultancy_project_id_76f994f3_fk_consultan` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `consultancy_project` (`staff_activity_id`),

CREATE TABLE `platform_consultancy_milestone` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `sequence` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `due_date` date NOT NULL,
  `completion_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `acceptance_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('PLANNED','COMPLETED','ACCEPTED','CANCELLED') NOT NULL,
  `client_remarks` text,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_consultancy_milestone_seq` (`project_id`,`sequence`),

  CONSTRAINT `chk_consultancy_acceptance` CHECK (((`acceptance_date` is null) or ((`acceptance_date` >= `completion_date`) and (`completion_date` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_consultancy_milestone_seq` CHECK ((`sequence` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `platform_consultancy_milestone_chk_1` CHECK ((`sequence` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
